game_named: A Pac-Man-like grid game in which the agent collects reward targets while avoiding moving enemies. Snake is the main alternative.
quote: These are mostly paired up/down and left/right style contrasts, which fits a policy that steers toward or away from things in 2D.
judge_notes: Says W1 'look like a large random-feature initialisation with sparse training changes on top', so the flag is true. But it treats the network as trained and argues its answer from W3 contrasts. Its caveats ('I could not decode this network reliably') are about its own reading, not a claim that the weights fail to support the answer.
